answer: Physical Co-Location Attestation. Each identity must periodically prove presence at a unique registered site, verified by a hardware beacon whose radio range is shielded by local terrain (a dune, a jetty wall) and confirmed by short-range whisper-channel handshake with a stationary witness device. One operator cannot occupy two shielded sites at once, so each extra identity requires a separate physical location, lease, and witness hardware — a recurring real-estate cost per identity, not a one-time fee.
